description: This header file declares functions and includes necessary for controlling an alternator in a firmware project. It defines initialization, configuration, and parameter setting functions for the alternator controller.

methods.name: initAlternatorCtrl
methods.description: Initializes the alternator controller with a shared logger.

methods.name: setAltPFactor
methods.description: Sets the proportional factor for the alternator control.

methods.name: setAltIFactor
methods.description: Sets the integral factor for the alternator control.

methods.name: setAltDFactor
methods.description: Sets the derivative factor for the alternator control.

methods.name: showAltInfo
methods.description: Displays information about the alternator state.

methods.name: onConfigurationChangeAlternatorCallback
methods.description: Callback function invoked when the configuration changes.
